title: ORGANIC CHEMISTRY LABORATORY
description: Laboratory course in organic chemistry for nonmajors, designed to supplement CH 331, CH 332 and CH 334, CH 335, CH 336.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ((CH 331 or 331H) and (CH 332 or 332H)) or (CH 334, 335 and 336).
A minimum grade of D- is required in CH 331, CH 331H, CH 332, CH 332H, CH 334, CH 335 and CH 336.
meeting_html: T 8am-11:50am in GBAD 209 - Gilbert Hall Addition 209 (9/23 to 12/4)
